glossary.title: ¿Jas are' ri tzij?
glossary.subtitle: Ucholaj rech taq tzij pa ri xolb'al rech ri Tinamït pa tzij yuwi'.
glossary.noResults: Man xetz'et ta wi taq tzij.

terms.definition: Are ri ronojel taq poy xkimatzij ri Aj Ch'akoj chi b'an pa ri juna'. Xb'an pa tikirib'al ri juna' xuquje' are ri tikirib'al ajawab'äl rech ri xolb'al.
terms.example: Wi xkimatzij ri Aj Ch'akoj Q50 millones, are ri xolb'al xkimatzij.

terms.definition: Are ri xolb'al xb'anatajinaq pa taq b'anatajib'äl pa ri juna'. Nïm o ti'j xpe pa ri xkimatzij.
terms.example: Wi xpe jub'a poy pa ri ajawarem, ri k'o chupam nïmb'ej.

terms.definition: Taq poy xb'an chik rech taq tzijonem, taq tzijob'äl o taq ch'akoj. K'o wi ri ch'ob'on, xa xe' man xel ta wi ri taq poy pa taq pa'ijb'äl.
terms.example: K'isb'äl tz'ib'am ri tzijob'äl rech taq oxe', ri taq poy xb'an chik.

terms.definition: Taq poy xel chik pa ri taq pa'ijb'äl rech ri Tinamït. Are ri ch'akoj xb'an chik chupam ri q'ij.
terms.example: K'isb'äl xb'an ri Tinamït ri b'ixan pa ri ajb'anom, xtz'ib'ax chi xel chik.

terms.definition: Are ri rucholaj rech ri xolb'al k'o xb'an chik o xel chik. Kuq'et jas nïm ri ch'akoj xb'an pa ri juna'.
terms.example: Jun rub'eyal 70% kuq'et xb'an chik 70% rech ri taq poy k'o.

terms.definition: Are ri nïm tz'aqat rech ri xolb'al. Ri ajb'anom kuq'et jun k'ojlib'äl ch'akoj rech ri Tinamït: tijonik, ajyuq', oxe', etc.
terms.example: Ri ajb'anom rech Ja' xuquje' K'isb'äl kukemow ronojel taq ch'akoj rech ja' k'isb'äl.

terms.definition: Are jun k'utb'äl chupam jun ajb'anom. Kub'an utz ri taq ch'akoj rech jun k'ojlib'äl nïm.
terms.example: Chupam ri ajb'anom Tijonik k'o wi jun tikel ajb'anom rech Tijonik pa Taq Tinamïtit.

terms.definition: Are jun ch'akoj k'o rub'eyal pa tikirib'al xuquje' pa ruk'isb'äl. Ri taq pixab'al kuya' jun rub'eyal ronojel chi tijox, chi b'e o chi ja'.
terms.example: Oxe' rech ri k'ayb'äl rech ri Tinamït are jun pixab'al.

terms.definition: Are ri taq b'anom k'o ta b'e o k'o wi ronojel q'ij rech ri Tinamït. Man k'o ta ruk'isb'äl chi je ri taq pixab'al.
terms.example: Ri ajilb'äl rech taq b'e are jun ch'akoj k'o ronojel q'ij.

terms.definition: Are ri rub'anikil nïm tikel rech ri ch'akoj. Kuq'et jun b'anom k'isb'äl chupam jun ch'akoj o pixab'al.
terms.example: Chupam ri ajilb'äl rech taq b'e, ri oxe' rech ri b'e 5 are jun oxe'.

terms.definition: Kuq'et ri rub'anikil ri ch'akoj: taq aqanik, taq ajb'anom, taq k'amow rub'eyal, etc. K'ïy taq tz'ib' k'o pa ri ruwäch MINFIN.
terms.example: Ri tz'ib' 011 rech taq aqanik, ri 022 rech taq q'aq'.

terms.definition: Kuq'et jas rub'eyal ri taq poy rech ri ch'akoj. Ri nïm taq rub'eyal are ri taq poy rech ri Tinamït, ri IVA Paz xuquje' ri Poy Ajawarem.
terms.example: Jun oxe' rech ja' k'isb'äl nïmb'ej kuya' ruk'in ri Poy Ajawarem.

terms.definition: Are ri 1.5% rech ri IVA xb'an ri ajawarem xuquje' xchap ri taq Tinamït. Are jun nïm rub'eyal poy rech taq oxe' xuquje' taq ch'akoj.
terms.example: Ronojel k'isb'äl xb'an IVA pa Guatemala, jun k'utb'äl xpe pa ri Tinamït chi IVA Paz.

terms.definition: Are ri 10% rech ri xolb'al ajawab'äl ri Choltzij rech Guatemala kumaj chi b'ixax pa taq Tinamït rech ri rub'eyal.
terms.example: Wi ri xolb'al ajawab'äl are Q100 mil millones, ri taq Tinamït kib'an Q10 mil millones.

terms.definition: Ajpatan Taq Poy Ajawab'äl Guatemala. Are ri ajawarem kukemow ri xolb'al ajawab'äl xuquje' kuya' ri taq b'ix ajawab'äl xb'an wakami pixab'al.
terms.example: Ronojel taq b'ix kilo wakami xpe pa ri ruwäch taq b'ix ajawab'äl rech MINFIN.

fuente.title: ¿Jas rub'eyal ri taq poy?
fuente.helpMessage: Ri Tinamït kuya' taq poy pa k'ïy rub'eyal: ri rub'ixik taq retamab'äl (taq tzijonem, taq ajk'amib'äl), ri IVA Paz xb'an ri ajawarem, ri Aporte Constitucional (10% rech ri xolb'al ajawab'äl) xuquje' junab'ik taq ulew.

programas.title: Ch'akoj pa Taq K'ojlib'äl
programas.helpMessage: Ri k'ojlib'äl kukemow taq ch'akoj rech ri Tinamït: ja' k'isb'äl, tijonik, taq nimsanik, ajb'anom, etc. Tiq'ax chi k'ojlib'äl chi kilo jas taq b'anom xb'an rech ri taq poy.

chart.helpMessageSingle: Ri säq tz'ib' kuq'et ri taq poy k'o. Ri tz'ib' color kuq'et jas xb'an chik chi b'an. Rumal wi are' ki'kotäj, are k'o wi rub'eyal ri xolb'al.
chart.helpMessageMulti: Kub'ij jas taq poy k'o (säq) vs jas xb'an chik chi b'an (color). Ri taq b'aq'wachib'äl kuq'et ri rub'eyal: q'an=ti'j, q'eq'al=chuwi', q'eq=nïm.
